# Alsyed Jalal AI

> Alsyed Jalal AI is a web-based AI workspace project focused on chat, research, coding, data analysis, documents, and agent workflows.

Primary website: https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/

## Public entry points
- Homepage: https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/
- Sitemap: https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://ai-syed-jalal-live.pages.dev/robots.txt

## Project areas
- AI workspace and multi-model workflow interface
- Research, coding, data analysis, and document workflows
- Agent orchestration and provider/API integration work
- Security, operations, and audit interfaces

## Important availability note
The presence of an interface or integration source file does not guarantee that a live provider is connected. Some capabilities require a separately deployed backend, a configured PostgreSQL database, provider API credentials, and server-side environment variables. Do not assume live authentication, database persistence, or provider execution unless the relevant endpoint reports healthy and the workflow has been tested.
